summary: APK/DEX analysis on demand: class lookup and reference search (upstream DroidASC, pure Python, no JVM)
notes: upstream 0.1.0 repackaged the tree as the `droidasc` package (pyproject requires-python >=3.10, androguard pinned to 4.1.3); the manager copies `droidasc/` next to `main.py` and runs the checkout entry point; without a local checkout the venv is built from the pinned upstream source archive, with the repo's own droidasc-v* source archive as the fallback
